cohort: The study included 80 patients aged 18 to 40 years with a history of one or more spontaneous abortions, irrespective of the period of gestation.
finding: Pregnancies in women with a history of previous spontaneous abortions are significantly associated with adverse pregnancy and foetal outcomes.
mod_finding: The majority of deliveries were LSCS (77.6%), and previous spontaneous delivery was significantly associated with the current type of delivery and foetal outcomes.
birth_weight: N/A (low birth weight mentioned as an outcome)
